head_frame_definitions.prepared_axes: +Y up/+Z forward; positions metres; angles degrees
head_frame_definitions.guard_calibrated: Qg is source0 prepared Head world rotation; F_local=Qg^-1 Z, ear/right_local=Qg^-1 X, guard pitch/roll0; positive pitch up
head_frame_definitions.fixed_rest_axis: rest Head world rotation calibrates prepared+Z; equivalent to former raw+X rest anatomical forward; guard here is approximately+4.48deg, not0
head_frame_definitions.anatomical_roll: ear/right vector angle in the level-heading right and forward/world-up reference; retained by the sagittal swing
head_frame_definitions.ear_line_elevation: asin(world ear/right Y); this literal line elevation can change with pitch even when anatomical roll is retained

chest_and_body_policy: Spine02 and all nodes outside the complete NeckTwist01 subtree retain v7 world matrices; Head-Hip lean may change and is not proof of chest correction.

policy.method: one constant prepared +Y BoneRoot translation from target idle at source zero
policy.region: body vertices with total same-side Foot/Toe skin weight greater than 0.5
policy.scope: idle, walk and three attacks share one target guard shift; no per-frame grounding or IK
policy.residual_policy: measure keys and midpoints without modifying authored relative foot heights

foot_samples_source.frame: prepared source before formal root shift; feet unchanged

limits: Native yaw and anatomical roll are retained; existing lateral head tilt is not flattened.
The new head/neck surface requires fresh full-body/steel BVH and visual verification.
No SDK/device behavior is validated by this private neck patch.
